III. DESCRIPTION OF PROPOSED FEDERAL HIGHWAY ADMINISTRATION ACTION
The propose improvement extends along F.A.P. Route 23 (U.S. Route 30) Limboln Highway from approximately two hundred (200) feet east of the Cicero Avenue centerline (western terminus) to approximately four hundred (400) feet west of the Chicago Road centerline (eastern terminus). The total length of the proposed improvement is approximately 4.6 miles.
Lincoln Highway (U.S. 30) between Cicero Avenue (Illinois Route 50) and Western Avenue is proposed to be reconstructed from a four (4) land undivided highway to three (3) twelve foot lanes in each direction separated by a sixteen (16) foot mountable median except for the section from Olympia Way to Brookwood Drive which will have a non-mountable median.
